notes:
Summary: Procurement stalled on legal redlines and vendor onboarding queue. Customer is a mid-to-large healthcare tech org evaluating private deployment for clinical triage and support use cases. POC completed (10k transcripts) with positive latency/cost signals but procurement/legal holding up rollout.

Key CRM timeline (shorthand):
- 2024-03-20: Intro call (AE Maya) - discovery, identified clinical triage pilot.
- 2024-04-12: Tech deep-dive (SE Diego) - latency targets 150ms p50 for short chat flows; embeddings rerank for doc search.
- 2024-06-01: POC kickoff - 30-day evaluation (private vpc).
- 2024-07-05: POC complete - passed perf and quality checks; customer product liked summarization outputs ("good enough for assist").
- 2024-08-14: Commercials discussion - estimated ARR band $250k-$750k, prefer annual commit.
- 2024-09-07: Legal intake - customer sent DPA + vendor questionnaire.
- 2024-09-21: Security review - requested SOC2 + encryption at rest + KMS integration details.
- 2024-10-03: Redwood legal submitted counters (re: liability cap, indemnity language).
- 2024-10-21: Joint call (AE/SE/Customer legal) - customer counsel said Redwood liability cap "too low", seeking higher cap and explicit carveouts for PHI handling.
- 2024-10-29: Internal reorder - Dir of AI (champion) promoted to VP product; new champion not assigned.
- 2024-11-02: Waiting on customer legal to return counters; procurement reports vendor onboarding queue into next quarter.

Detailed procurement blockers:
- DPA redlines: customer legal requests higher liability cap for PHI exposure, explicit PHI breach obligations, and retention/residency guarantees. They want 90-day data purging SLA for clinical transcripts (we proposed 30 days).
- MSA terms: indemnity and IP carveouts flagged; customer counsel requesting changes we typically don't accept without insurance proof.
- Vendor onboarding: security questionnaire incomplete items (pen-test report older than 12 months, KMS integration diagrams). Customer procurement says their vendor ops team has a backlog and new vendors are batched monthly.
- Internal org: previous champion moved to different role; momentum slowed until a new sponsor is identified in product or clinical ops.

What we've offered/next moves tried:
- Provided SOC2 report and network diagram (drive link).
- Offered to run an architecture call with their Infosec and KMS team week of 2024-11-06.
- Proposed escalation: discounted onboarding and extended SLA for data deletion to 60 days as compromise.
- Legal suggested an optional addendum limiting PHI processing scope and enhanced logging; awaiting counters from their counsel.

Sales notes + quotes:
- Customer product lead: "POC results exceeded our baseline on recall, but legal is being conservative on PHI."
- Procurement: "We batch vendor starts — even if legal signs, onboarding could be 6+ weeks."

Action items (assigned):
- Maya: coordinate legal-to-legal touchpoint; request list of required policy docs by 2024-11-05.
- Diego: prep KMS integration diagram and updated pen-test summary (target 2024-11-08).
- Anika (CSM): prepare initial onboarding checklist to accelerate once legal clears.

Win-risk assessment: high risk until DPA counters resolved and new champion assigned. Time-sensitive: budget freeze language for Q1 2025 referenced internally.

Stated next_steps summary: "Legal to return counters by 2024-11-09. If counters acceptable, schedule Infosec architecture call and request procurement slot. If no return by 2024-11-16, deprioritize for Q1 re-engagement."
